Name: Zollan Cat (Content Patcher)
Author: waffletoast215
Description: Edits the gray cat's sprites to look like (the smaller cat based on) Zollan seen in an eyecatch from Slayers Revolution.  These are just sprite recolors with a little ascot added. I decided to not give him clothes to set him apart from the actual Zollan seen in Slayers Revolution, this is just a "real" cat based on him which is seen in one of the eyecatches (shown in the thumbnail) to be a cute little pet. Goes well with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19781]Lina Inverse mod[/url] if you choose to marry her!
